# sec-filing-ingestion — Roadmap

## Outcomes

Source: your partner's words, 2026-11-10. Background: specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md, specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-adr.md.
Choices made: none.

| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | The quarterly and daily index files, ingested into one filing-index table | A | 1 | Small: about 130 quarterly files since 1993 plus one daily file per business day, minutes of downloading at 3 requests/s (SEC full-index and daily-index directories); measured by Stage 1 |
| O2 | The individual submissions that the index rows name, downloaded | A | 2 | Large: millions of files, weeks for the full history at 3 requests/s (index row count × request rate, not yet measured); measured per quarter by Stage 2 |
| O3 | 10-K and 8-K filings handled: picked out of the submissions, with their main documents extracted | A | 3 | Unknown until submissions are on disk; measured by Stage 3 |

Tracks: A — SEC filing ingestion (known progression).

## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Filing-index core
      Objective: Load the real quarterly and daily index files into one filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: the uv workspace scaffold as committed (no working code)
      Produces: a filing-index table that later stages can read; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: the table holds the rows of every quarterly index in the chosen range plus the daily indexes since, from a real run; the findings file records file count, bytes, row count, elapsed time and observed request rate
      Leaves out: manifests and traceability (Stage 4); point-in-time publication (Stage 5); full validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Submission download
      Objective: Download the submissions that the filing-index rows name.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table
      Produces: submissions on disk, addressable from their index rows; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-2-findings.md
      Exit: every submission named by one real quarter's index rows is on disk or listed as failed; the findings file records files, bytes, elapsed time and request rate for that quarter
      Leaves out: manifests and traceability (Stage 4); full validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment of the full-history download (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: 10-K and 8-K handling
      Objective: Pick 10-K and 8-K filings out of the downloaded submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's downloaded submissions
      Produces: extracted main documents for 10-K and 8-K filings; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-3-findings.md
      Exit: for the quarter Stage 2 downloaded, each 10-K and 8-K has its main document extracted or is listed as failed with a reason; the findings file records counts, failures and elapsed time
      Leaves out: manifests and traceability (Stage 4); full validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Manifests and traceability
      Objective: Record where every index row, submission and extracted document came from, so any output can be traced to and replayed from its retained source bytes.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3 (hardening)
      Consumes: Stages 1–3 outputs
      Produces: source and processing manifests covering all three outputs
      Exit: any row, submission or extracted document resolves to its source URL and retained bytes; a reprocessing run reads retained bytes with no SEC requests
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Point-in-time publication
      Objective: Publish the filing-index table as versioned generations so readers see a complete, identifiable version and later quarterly changes are recorded rather than overwritten.
      Outcomes: O1 (hardening)
      Consumes: Stage 4's manifests
      Produces: versioned generations of the filing-index table with a recorded current version
      Exit: a reader can name and re-read the version it used; a changed quarterly source produces a new version with its changes recorded, and the prior version stays readable
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Full validation suite
      Objective: Cover the historical index formats, submission layouts and failure cases with committed fixtures in CI.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3 (hardening)
      Consumes: Stages 1–5
      Produces: a CI suite on committed fixtures that downloads nothing from the SEC
      Exit: CI passes on fixtures for every index format in the chosen range and for malformed, truncated and HTML-error inputs, which fail closed
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Scheduling and deployment
      Objective: Run index ingestion daily and the submission download as a bounded campaign, deployed and scheduled.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3 (hardening)
      Consumes: Stages 1–6
      Produces: a deployed, scheduled system with run reports
      Exit: observed scheduled daily runs ingest new index files, and the submission campaign reports per-quarter progress and gaps
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming
